root_cause: The production GitHub attestation attempted to download provider Edge source using a Supabase access token rejected as HTTP 401 Invalid access token. It retried 24 times although no retry could repair credentials. The already deployed independent bg-pre-publish-review function was absent from the canonical Supabase function config, so provider source resolution omitted it. The merged source release was not deployed.
prevention: Declare the existing reviewer in protected-main runtime config with its current JWT mode, fail fast on invalid readback credentials with a specific error, preserve the exclusive Supabase GitHub integration as deployer, and require provider readback. The credential owner must rotate the invalid GitHub Actions secret; the code never manufactures or logs secrets, disables gates, or claims publication.

evidence.supabase_live: Reviewer version 29, publisher version 288; original review-freshness/retry changes not live.
evidence.runtime_config: The reviewer was absent from supabase/config.toml, though provider reports it active.
